name: Unidentified lava planet
description: A lava planet was located in the galaxy. Under the rule of the Galactic Empire, a rebel cell known as the Spectres, came in their starship Ghost, and picked up some supplies, destroyed machines and a com array, liberated prisoners of the Empire, and destroyed a TIE fighter.
